# New Thunderbird metrics files need a separate probe-scraper registration PR

Fresh full one-file29-line documentation patch read. It adds a separate manual step for new Glean metrics or ping files: open a PR adding the file path to repositories.yaml under thunderbird_desktop in probe-scraper. Fixed accepted source retains these exact instructions. This is a checked-in instruction for another repository, not proof that any particular file is currently registered there or that metrics upload works.

Scope: Telemetry metrics registration docs.
